headline: Rotate session-headed ledgers using real UTF-8 byte budgets

items.title: Rotate session-headed ledgers using real UTF-8 byte budgets
items.insight: Session-first headings bypass the existing rotator, and Unicode records outgrow character-count budgets. Extend the existing tool with conservative date recognition, real byte accounting and preservation checks.
items.evidence: Session-first and date-first dated entries rotate oldest-first; undated sections and complete recent entries stay hot; Unicode sizes use UTF-8 bytes; real CLI fixtures preserve the exact preimage, archive every removed complete block, refuse conflicting archives, and rerun idempotently. Full source checks and authorized staging/production acceptance remain required.
